Read the WP-SCP-022 Track 2 slice ordering and constraints.
Inspect current MCP server registration points before wiring resources.
Inspect existing 021C tool behavior and parsing helpers for compatibility.
Catch syntax/import issues after adding the resource implementation and tests.

Re-run the focused MCP resource tests after fixes.
Run the scoped verification command required by the work package.

files_changed_self_report.rationale: Added committed-state MCP resource implementation, HEAD-keyed caching, per-id URI handling, and server registration helpers for slice 021D.
Registered MCP resources on server startup as allowed for this slice.
Updated the handshake expectation from empty resources to the new static MCP resource set.
Made the new resource test package importable for relative helper imports.
Added committed git-repo fixture helpers and FastMCP resource test utilities.
Covered registry happy path and HEAD-cache invalidation.
Covered glob-to-domain mapping and per-rule isolation.
Covered per-id template registration and routing for rule/waiver/finding/decision URIs.
Covered signing-key resource parsing and serving.
Covered the committed-state-only invariant against uncommitted edits.

self_reported_concerns: The committed standards registry does not currently carry explicit `applies_to` fields, and the scope boundary forbade edits under `standards/**`; `mcp_server/resources.py` therefore synthesizes fallback `applies_to` mappings when the committed registry omits them, while honoring explicit registry values if/when they are added later.
Resource payloads include `schema_version` and `key_id`, but transport-level resource-update notification behavior is not explicitly exercised by the current MCP test suite.
codex_structured_result.summary: Implemented WP-SCP-022 Track 2 slice 021D by adding committed-state MCP resources in `src/standards_control_plane/mcp_server/resources.py`, wiring resource registration into `ScpMcpServer`, and adding resource-focused MCP tests plus the handshake update. The resource layer reads only from committed git state via `git show`/`git ls-tree`, uses a HEAD-commit-sha256 keyed cache, exposes the required static and per-id/template URIs, and the scoped verification suite passed (`python3 -m pytest tests/scp_mcp/ -xvs` => 52 passed).
